Round 181 is planned and the decision is **CONTINUE**. Round 180 passed C with 0 bugs, and the next task is M1: the Transport Play button becomes round and icon-only.

**Round 180 result**
- C PASS in a real browser (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` both true). Root published it as `59d4bab`, and that commit matches C's verified end tree.
- DUX-R-5b-3b and the whole DUX-R-5 stage (the one colour rule) are now **მზადაა**. The stage-exit check of every remaining brass token found 0 unmapped.
- Closed: B-R174-ACCENT-EQ-BRAND and C-R179-DOC147-STALE.
- One sub-check stays BLOCKED, not failed: the fake-Bearer 403 needs the backend, which isn't available in the cloud.
- I ruled on C's info notes (all vetoable): A's structural test lookups are accepted; masking the playhead pixels in the brass scan is accepted, with one re-scan added to the regression round; my own wrong mutation expectation in round 180 (m296) is recorded.

**Round 181 = M1, from HEAD `59d4bab`**
- **Why M1:** the last regression was 2026-10-24, only 2 days ago, so it isn't due yet. M1 is next in the VISUAL-A order and Saba approved it on 2026-10-21.
- **Change:** the Play/Pause button goes from 96×32 with a text label to a 32×32 circle with just the icon. Its accessible name stays exactly `Play` / `Pause`.
- **My added choice (vetoable):** a tooltip `Play (Space)` / `Pause (Space)`, so the action and its shortcut are still discoverable once the label is gone.
- **Layout prediction:** I measured this in real Chromium with an in-page simulation. At both viewports the 10 controls after Play move 64 px left; the right-hand group, the row heights and everything below stay put. C gets these as expected values.
- **Files A may change:** 6 (the Transport component, the strings module and its key test, the transport test, and status-only edits to docs 147 and 148), plus a new doc 149. No new test file. 999 files are frozen and protected, including the auth and purchase files.
- **Tests:** a 15-file targeted base gives 229/229 on the start tree. A also runs five mutations (m299–m303).
- **C's checks:** shape and colours, layout against HEAD, contrast, the focus ring, a brass scan, real playback by click and by Space, accessibility, purchase protection and network hygiene.
- **Ableton:** I fetched the Live 12 manual §6.3. Its text confirms separate Play and Stop buttons, and that Space toggles playback. CZABA's single Play/Pause toggle is an existing, deliberate difference. Whether Live's button is icon-only is unverified, because I didn't view the figure.

- A new bounded architecture checkpoint request for root, `b-round-180-checkpoint-request.md`, with three questions: whether to extract the repeated class recipes, whether to share the test setup with ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS, and the order. It doesn't block anything and replaces the round-173 request.
- The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. It caught two count errors in the task, now fixed.
- Any planning on or after 2026-10-27 makes the next round the regression round, expected to be round 182; M3 follows it.
